{{Infobox artifact|name=The Marginal Notes|type=Scattered scholarship|keeper=The margins of other people's books}}
'''The Marginal Notes''' are the scribbles of scattered individual historians in the margins of the official record — questions, objections, calculations that don't add up. ''"A seal is missing here."'' ''"Why is year 3 empty?"'' ''"Count the seals."''

Several of these historians disappeared. The Notes are the realm's investigative voice, and the most dangerous one to use.
